name: Men And Women Living Together
overview: Scripture establishes that men and women are designed to live together in a covenantal relationship, as God created woman to be a suitable helper for man and instituted marriage for them to become one flesh (Genesis 2:18, 24). This union is affirmed as the proper context for male-female companionship, while sexual relations outside this design, including those condemned as abominations, are forbidden (Leviticus 18:22). God’s word serves as a guiding light for living rightly, emphasizing the blessing and strength found in companionship (Psalms 119:105; Ecclesiastes 4:9). The faithfulness to God’s covenantal plan is underscored by His ongoing commitment to His people (Judges 2:1).
